gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS transaction_amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT c.customer_level, SUM(t.amount) AS transaction_amount FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY c.customer_level
SELECT c.region, SUM(t.amount) AS transaction_amount FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS transaction_customer_count FROM transactions WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS avg_amount_per_customer FROM transactions WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT p.product_type, SUM(t.amount) AS transaction_amount FROM transactions t JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY p.product_type

SELECT c.customer_level, p.product_type, SUM(t.amount) AS transaction_amount FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY c.customer_level, p.product_type ORDER BY c.customer_level, p.product_type
SELECT SUM(converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns
SELECT touch_channel, SUM(converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns GROUP BY touch_channel ORDER BY touch_channel
SELECT campaign_type, SUM(converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type

SELECT c.customer_level, SUM(ca.converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns ca JOIN customers c ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY c.customer_level
SELECT c.region, SUM(ca.converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns ca JOIN customers c ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN converted = 1 THEN customer_id END) AS converted_customer_count FROM campaigns
SELECT touch_channel, SUM(converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS campaign_conversion_rate FROM campaigns GROUP BY touch_channel ORDER BY campaign_conversion_rate DESC LIMIT 1
